title: Success Manager - Partner Insights & Enablement
description:
Success Manager - Partner Insights & Enablement

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Manager will sit within the Success team on the Partner Insights, Enablement and Success team. This role will own strategic customer relationships with healthcare systems, life sciences organizations, and research partners, helping customers translate complex clinical questions into successful real-world data and evidence workflows. The ideal candidate combines enterprise healthcare technology customer success experience - especially experience with EMR data or EMR vendors - with a strong foundation in clinical practice, real-world data or evidence, public health, outcomes research, or epidemiology. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own a portfolio of Truveta customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, research execution, renewal readiness, and expansion. Develop success plans, establish measurable outcomes, and ensure customers realize sustained value from Truveta. 
  • Guide customers through research and analytics workflows, including cohort definition, feasibility assessment, study design considerations, data interpretation, and effective use of Truveta products and services. 
  • Translate customer goals, clinical workflows, and research questions into clear requirements, action plans, and deliverables. Coordinate across product, research, engineering, commercial, and support teams to drive resolution and progress. 
  • Manage customer education, enablement, training, and stakeholder and executive-ready communications. Clearly summarize research findings, product capabilities, risks, and recommendations in Truveta-branded reports, slide decks, and presentations. 
  • Build trusted relationships with clinical, operational, informatics, analytics, and research stakeholders at health systems and life sciences organizations. Serve as a strategic advisor and customer advocate. 
  • Identify opportunities to deepen product adoption and expand customer impact. Partner with commercial teams on account planning, renewal preparation, and growth opportunities. 
  • Proactively identify delivery, workflow, or adoption risks and develop practical recommendations for resolution. 
  • Occasional but mandatory domestic travel (~2-5x/yr), plus the ability to attend virtual meetings across US time zones. 

Required Skills:

  • 4+ years of experience working in a field which developed exposure to and understanding of electronic medical record (EMR) data, real-world data (RWD), real world evidence (RWE), public health research, or regulatory submissions. 
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting, ideally with a focus on life science or healthcare analytics customers. 
  • Demonstrated experience with public health research, epidemiology, outcomes research, health services research, real-world data (RWD), real-world evidence (RWE), or clinical research. 
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align clinical, technical, operational, and executive audiences around shared goals and deliverables. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific, analytical, and technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of familiarity. 
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple customer priorities simultaneously. 
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to timely, high-quality execution. 
  • High degree of professionalism, curiosity, empathy, and enthusiasm for Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data. 
  • Direct experience working at an EMR vendor, or substantial experience implementing, supporting, or advising customers on Epic or Cerner platforms and workflows is an absolute plus.

Preferred Qualifications: 

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don’t already have experience with them.  

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, epidemiology, health services research, biomedical informatics, biostatistics, health economics, or another quantitative or health-related discipline. 
  • Experience supporting health systems, life sciences organizations, academic researchers, or government/public health customers using clinical data for research, quality improvement, or evidence generation. 
  • Experience with clinical data models, EHR workflows, interoperability, population health, registries, analytics, or clinical informatics. 
  • Experience with statistical analysis or querying tools such as SQL, R, Python, or similar technologies. 

Why Truveta?   

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.  

We Offer:

  • Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage
  • Great benefits package
  • Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • 401K plan
  • Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Generous parental leave
  • Regular team activities (virtual and in-person as soon as we are able)
  • The base pay for this position is $105,000 to $130,000. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. To provide technical leadership and hands-on contribution within a data engineering team, designing, building, and optimizing robust data pipelines and infrastructure for a global sports betting and media business. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. title: Analytics Engineer, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering team.

The area sits at the heart of some of the most critical customer journeys and commercial systems across Vinted’s Marketplace Business Unit, spanning Revenue (pricing and advertising), Purchase (inquiries and checkout), and Orders (transactions and fulfilment). Together, these domains create a rich, high-volume, and deeply interconnected data ecosystem.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building trusted data products that power business and product decision-making across these domains.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Build scalable data products: Design, develop, and evolve reliable, cost-efficient data products and pipelines that power analytics and machine learning use cases across the domains.
  • Build quality in by design: Embed automated testing, validation, and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure data remains accurate, consistent, and complete.
  • Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and alerting to detect and address issues before they impact downstream consumers.
  • Own production reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of production data systems, from investigating incidents and diagnosing root causes to implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence and improve long-term resilience.

Who you’ll work with:

  • Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering: Join a talented and driven team of 7+ Analytics Engineers, working across interconnected domains and tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.
  • Data & Decision Scientists: Work closely with Data Scientists and Decision Scientists to build trusted data foundations that enable better business and product decisions.
  • Engineering, Product & Business: Partner with Backend Engineering, Product, and Business teams to understand their needs, shape technical requirements, and translate them into well-designed, trusted data solutions.
  • The Analytics Engineering Guild: Be an active member of Vinted’s 40+ member AE Guild, benefiting from shared tooling, engineering standards, and knowledge across domains. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to “side quests” that improve engineering practices, tooling, and reusable capabilities.

About you 

  • Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or in a closely related data role.
  • Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals, with the ability to build clean, performant, and maintainable data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework, building well-structured and tested data models.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.
  • A solid understanding of data modelling principles and their application to real-world analytical problems.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, business-critical data, balancing a high bar for quality and reliability with a pragmatic bias for action.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions. You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility. This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world. What we think you need to be successful Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL) Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…) Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk. Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery. Dit ben jij Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving. Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Peer Review Operations Specialist - 2 Year FTC
description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

As a Peer Review Operations Specialist, you are a confident and highly organized self-starter, motivated by a culture of continuous improvement. You’re an excellent communicator and a natural team player, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and hold yourself accountable for meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Reporting to the Peer Review Operations Manager, you work as a member of the Peer Review Operations team to maintain efficient peer review workflows, ensure high vendor performance standards, and uphold excellent contributor experience for authors, editors, and reviewers. You will enforce turnaround time benchmarks for all peer review milestones to protect process integrity and ensure timeliness and quality of publication. You will have high standards of professional conduct in the workplace, and enjoy working with international colleagues from a range of cultures and settings. You will seek out opportunities for continuous quality improvement in department activities and be an effective champion of the PLOS vision, mission, and brand.

Responsibilities

Submission Management 

  • Ensure the timely, efficient peer review of all submissions
  • Ensure that queries or concerns escalated by vendors, Customer Care or other PLOS colleagues are addressed and resolved professionally and within required timelines, or escalated appropriately
  • Identify and remove barriers to submission, working collaboratively with colleagues across PLOS as required
  • Proactively identify workflow inefficiencies, variations or backlogs to diagnose persistent issues 
  • Ensure that manuscripts meet requirements and follow current policies and procedures

Workflows 

  • Troubleshoot persistent manuscript, workflow or system issues, providing expertise and advice, and exercising judgement to resolve the issue or escalate to the Peer Review Operations Manager or other colleagues as appropriate
  • Proactively raise data-driven recommendations for continuous journal operations and workflow improvements to the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Ensure standard journal workflows are maintained as established, implementing and adopting process updates when approved by the Peer Review Operations Manager

Projects 

  • Contribute to workflow project and initiate proposals as requested, and undertake operations projects and initiatives as directed by the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Serve as daily liaison with vendor representatives, monitoring quality and timeliness performance against target thresholds and KPIs

Other 

  • Contribute to other operational research outputs related to PLOS’s mission where required, so that our journal workflows are optimised to encourage scientific openness and transparency

Knowledge and Skills

Essential

  • Prior experience in peer-reviewed schololarly publishing
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral
  • Growth mindset with a collaborative, team player mentality
  • An ability to maintain a positive and professional customer service attitude
  • Able to work constructively with vendors, authors, editors, customers, and colleagues from a range of international settings
  • Knowledge of Excel, Word, file types and file conversions
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy
  • Able to set priorities and work independently
  • Upholds high standards of professionalism in the workplace
  • Embraces change with a positive attitude
  • An interest in science and in advancing scientific knowledge

Desirable

  • Knowledge of and expertise with peer review and manuscript management database systems; proficiency with Editorial Manager a plus
  • Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) software such as Salesforce
  • Awareness of and commitment to open science

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some domestic and international travel required.

Qualifications

  • A university degree or equivalent experience 

 

The base salary range we've established for these positions is £27,000- £30,000. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

title: Public Sector Partner Manager
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Elastic is looking for a Public Sector Partner Manager to build and grow a high-performing ecosystem of Global System Integrators (GSIs) and Influence Partners (IPs) across the UK Public Sector.

You will develop strategic partnerships that help government organisations overcome fragmented data, strengthen cyber resilience, modernise operations, and build trusted foundations for AI adoption.

Working across Central Government, Defence, Healthcare, Public Safety, Education, and Critical National Infrastructure, you will enable partners to deliver measurable customer outcomes while driving sustainable growth for both Elastic and our ecosystem.

Success is measured by the strength of the partner community you build, the capabilities you develop, the customer outcomes you enable, and the long-term value you create.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow strategic GSI and IP partnerships across UK Public Sector.
  • Create executive relationships that drive joint growth and customer success.
  • Develop partner capabilities through enablement, certifications, and solution development.
  • Lead joint go-to-market initiatives with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Services, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through strategic account planning and pursuit engagement.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, reuse, and innovation across the ecosystem.
  • Help partners deliver solutions across Cyber Resilience, Security Operations, Observability, Operational Intelligence, Search, and AI.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience building and growing strategic technology partnerships.
  • Strong understanding of UK Public Sector and associated procurement frameworks.
  • Experience working with GSIs, IPs, consultancies, and technology ecosystems.
  • A customer-first mindset with a passion for solving complex challenges.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with a bias for execution and measurable outcomes.

Success Looks Like

  • Trusted relationships with priority partners and key executives.
  • Increased partner capability, certifications, and delivery capacity.
  • Repeatable co-sell and co-delivery motions across Public Sector.
  • Meaningful partner-generated pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Strong customer outcomes that reinforce Elastic's reputation as a trusted Public Sector platform.

If you're passionate about building ecosystems, creating customer impact, and helping shape the future of UK Public Sector technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

title: Small to Midsize Strategy Leader - Clinical Data
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems is seeking a Strategy Leader responsible for growing the Clinical Data business with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
The small and medium-sized business (SMB) Strategy Leader of Clinical Data requires a familiarity with clinical research and/or healthcare data flow. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to drive adoption discussions based on credibility and knowledge across multiple domains, including pharma/biotech, CRO, and technology partnership. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to challenge customers to adopt new operating models and change their traditional way of thinking.
 
Vault Clinical Data comprises Electronic Data Capture (EDC) and Data Quality System (DQS). This role will be responsible for driving Clinical Data market strategy and growth across our emerging and mid-size  customers, working with the sales team, ensuring customer success, and developing a tailored market approach for customers with small internal teams. To achieve these goals the Strategy Leader of Clinical Data will need to connect with clinical and data management leaders, clinical operations leaders and IT leadership to create strategic plans that deliver and demonstrate customer success, and work directly with sales to identify and win opportunities to grow the business.
 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of industry and technology leaders, who, together, are bringing the next generation of clinical development and R&D applications to Life Sciences.
 
This position can be based anywhere in North America.

title: Solutions Delivery Manager
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity. Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas — unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space. Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer. Hoe ontwerp je een weg, brug of tunnel die veilig, duurzaam én uitvoerbaar is? Tijdens jouw ontwerpstage bij Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten ontdek je hoe jouw kennis in de praktijk samenkomt. Volg jij een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Built Environment of vergelijkbaar? Je werkt mee aan grote infraprojecten, leert van ervaren ontwerpers en ontdekt welke ontwerprichting bij jou past. Dit wordt jouw stage Een goed infraproject begint bij een slim en integraal ontwerp. Binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten werken we met verschillende vakgroepen samen om complexe plannen te vertalen naar veilige, duurzame en uitvoerbare ontwerp oplossingen. Binnen het cluster werken collega’s vanuit ontwerpmanagement, civiel ontwerp – waaronder definitieve constructies, hulpconstructies en geotechniek – en Ontwerp GWW, met disciplines als wegontwerp, wegbouwkunde, ecologie en wateradvies. Daarnaast zijn ook omgevingsmanagement en technische installaties onderdeel van het cluster. Met dit cluster zorgen we ervoor dat een ontwerp niet alleen technisch klopt, maar ook maakbaar is en past binnen zijn omgeving. Als stagiair draai je mee binnen een vakgebied dat aansluit bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Je werkt mee aan echte projecten, krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en ontdekt hoe jouw bijdrage onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Zo bouw je bij Dura Vermeer niet alleen mee aan de infrastructuur van Nederland, maar ook aan je eigen toekomst. Hier zit je op je plek Je gaat aan de slag bij Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten en je bent betrokken bij de grootste en uitdagendste projecten van Dura Vermeer. Neem bijvoorbeeld de renovatie van de Drechttunnel, de aanleg van de infrastructuur van de containerterminal APM, de aanleg van de A15 nabij Arnhem of projecten die bijdragen aan de energietransitie zoals de bouw van de eerste 2GW Landstation in Nederland. Dit doe je samen met gedreven collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Jij wordt onderdeel van de ontwerporganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Het cluster bestaat momenteel uit circa 160 collega’s, daarmee geven wij invulling aan onze ambitie als ontwerpende bouwer. Je werkt samen met mensen op de bouwplaats en deskundigen vanuit de leveranciers. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo of wo opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Built Environment, Mobiliteit, Geotechniek of soort gelijk; Je bent op zoek naar een stage voor minimaal 4 dagen per week; Je bent proactief en durft vragen te stellen; Je bent flexibel, kan omgaan met veranderingen en werkt georganiseerd; Je hart gaat sneller kloppen van ontwerpen. Je werkt tijdens je stage samen met fijne collega's die zorgen voor een leuke en professionele werksfeer; Stage lopen én plezier maken: van kennismaking op de introductiedag tot leuke activiteiten en projectbezoeken met collega’s en mede stagiaires. title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Technical Advisor, Surveillance, Data Use and Decision Science (Remote - Kinshasa, DRC)
description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives' Prevent Epidemics program works closely with Ministries of Health and national public health institutes in Africa to strengthen epidemic preparedness capacity, accelerate disease detection and response, and effectively use data to inform action. In addition to direct partnerships with governments, we also work with implementing partners, including the US CDC, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, to implement programs, prototype innovations, and ensure sustainability through increased national ownership, including domestic budget allocations.

Position Purpose:  

RTSL is seeking a Technical Advisor for Surveillance, Data Use and Decision Science. This position aims to strengthen collaboration, governance, and the use of public health data to improve disease surveillance at the national and subnational levels. The advisor will provide technical support to the structures responsible for surveillance in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), including the National Public Health Institute (INSP), its Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COUSP), the Directorate of Epidemiological Surveillance (DSE), disease control programs, and the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB), in order to use data to detect threats, track alerts, analyze 7-1-7 timelines, and guide public health decisions. They will develop simple, useful information products, train teams, and help identify delays in detection, notification, investigation, confirmation, and early response. 

The position will be a part of the RTSL DRC team and will support national institutions, without substituting for their mandates. The Technical Advisor will work with national technical teams and contribute to the development of simple, useful, and prioritized information products. They will train teams and help identify delays in detection, notification, investigation, confirmation, and early response — particularly weekly epidemiological reports, situation reports or investigated events, as well as 7-1-7 analyses, epidemiological bulletins, and risk information products — in order to support decision-making that strengthens preparedness, response, and health security in the DRC. They will benefit from RTSL's technical support. 

This is a one-year, renewable fixed-term contract with a 3-month probationary period. 

Core Duties and Responsibilities: 

Responsibilities will cover the full data lifecycle, including but not limited to: 

Technical Support & Mentorship: 

  • Collaborate with directors and decision-makers responsible for public health emergency management to identify data needs for decision-making 
  • Provide direct coaching and technical assistance to relevant INSP staff responsible for developing priority information products, including 7-1-7 dashboards, based on consensus and approval from relevant managers 
  • Identify bottlenecks related to the sharing, governance, and use of data relevant to public health emergency preparedness and response, and collaborate with relevant departments to address and resolve these challenges 
  • Provide guidance, technical mentoring, and capacity-building support to INSP staff and other stakeholders in data management, analysis, visualization, and interpretation, particularly the 7-1-7 detection, notification, investigation, confirmation, and early response timelines 
  • Strengthen capacities in data analysis and visualization, including statistical modeling and real-time dashboards, aiming to improve surveillance reporting and outbreak response through mentoring and structured training 
  • Support the prioritization and design of information products among various stakeholders, both within INSP and with other national surveillance structures 
  • Collaborate with INSP teams, surveillance structures, and RTSL teams working on data architecture to support initiatives aimed at improving data governance and coordination of public health emergency management 
  • Support the translation and implementation of data structures to promote data use and automation of data processing pipelines 
  • Provide technical support for the development of strategic documents and guidelines aimed at improving the national surveillance architecture and data governance  

Development of Information Products: 

  • Support staff at surveillance structures, including INSP, and relevant stakeholders in developing or improving key data products, particularly weekly epidemiological reports, epidemiological bulletins, situation reports, and risk information products  
  • Contribute to improving data visualization dashboards, predictive analysis models, and automated reporting systems to strengthen disease surveillance and risk assessment  
  • Ensure alignment of data products with the One Health approach 

Data-Driven Decision-Making & Capacity Building: 

  • Analyze 7-1-7 data related to detection, notification, investigation, confirmation, and early response initiation. Produce useful insights to guide decisions, identify bottlenecks, and prioritize activation of the rapid response fund  
  • Support INSP in transforming surveillance data, epidemiological data, and 7-1-7 data into actionable insights for public health decision-making  
  • Identify capacity-building needs for data use, including staff training in basic epidemiology, R, data science, and data analysis  
  • Organize training workshops, seminars, and hands-on sessions for staff at surveillance structures including INSP, DSE, INRB, disease control programs, provincial teams, and health zone epidemiologists to strengthen their analytical skills  
  • Facilitate the development and implementation of a data use strategy to improve the quality, accessibility, and usefulness of health data for better decision-making 

 Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: 

  • Support activities to strengthen regular sharing of data useful for epidemic and pandemic preparedness and response, among surveillance structures including INSP, DSE, INRB, disease control programs, provincial teams, other sectors, ministries, departments, and agencies  
  • Identify opportunities for collaboration and support among surveillance structures including INSP, DSE, INRB, disease control programs, provincial teams, and other ministries, departments, and agencies to improve data sharing and use, as well as synergies in preparedness, epidemic response, and implementation of the 7-1-7 approach  
  • Provide technical support and facilitate stakeholder engagement for new or existing initiatives aimed at improving data governance and coordination  
  • Facilitate support for processes and workflows, including support for regular meetings of routine surveillance and emergency preparedness teams, such as EIR, EMU, and technical working groups  
  • Support meetings focused on data sharing and data product innovations, as well as multisectoral workshops focused on joint data projects and data-sharing agreements  
  • Carry out any other related tasks assigned by RTSL 

Required Qualifications:  

Education:  

  • Master’s or PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, Public Health, Health Informatics, or a related field 
  • Proficiency in English is a strong asset 

Experience: 

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in public health or related discipline in health data analytics, disease surveillance, or decision science, preferably within a public health or government agency 
  • Demonstrated experience in capacity-building, training, and mentorship of public health professionals 

Skills & competencies: 

  • Strong understanding of public health, data compilation, management, and analysis, including understanding of public health informatics and the importance of data in supporting health surveillance and emergency management 
  • Advanced R skills, including data preparation, descriptive statistics, data visualization, geospatial mapping 
  • Intermediate proficiency in R Shiny and Quarto or Markdown for creating interactive applications and automated reports 
  • Good understanding of programming principles to organize and execute complex data pipelines and information product generation into replicable and comprehensible structure. 
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with experience working with government agencies, development partners, and global health organizations 
  • Strong understanding of International Health Regulations (IHR 2005), Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR), and One Health approaches 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, analytical, report writing, presentation and interpersonal skills for engaging and influencing non-governmental partners, donors, and multilateral agencies, with the ability to present complex information to non-technical audiences in an effective manner 
  • Results and impact-oriented, with a problem-solving attitude and attention to detail 
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team, with a collaborative mindset 

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.

The salary for this role is competitive and set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector in DRC. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate’s skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

 

 

 

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will work within our Translational Medicine group analyzing and interpreting molecular and clinical data. Analysis will focus on using genomic, protein and other targeted assays to identify and validate predictive biomarkers. The computational clinical scientist will work on various projects in different phases of drug development and contribute to the cross-functional team which includes other bioinformaticians, program leads, medical monitors, biostatisticians other pre-clinical scientists.

  • Integrate multiple data sources including circulating tumor DNA, patient enrollment data, molecular profiling (RNA/DNA sequencing outputs), multiplex immunohistochemistry to identify and validate new biomarkers for candidate drugs.

  • Work with internal groups, contract research organizations and collaborators to deliver validated biomarker data and analysis.

  • Support the development of biomarker related aspects of the trial design where bioinformatic analysis is required, including study protocols, lab manuals, clinical study reports, and other regulatory documents.

  • Work with biomarker scientists to support analysis of biomarker readouts (summary statistics, and visualization of efficacy in molecular subgroups).

  • Collaborate with preclinical bioinformaticians to design, analyze and interpret experiments to validate biomarkers, understand compound mechanism of action, and identify biomarkers for patient selection and target engagement.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in bioinformatics, biology, data science or a related field with emphasis on biological data analysis.

  • 2+ years of pharmaceutical or biotech experience in bioinformatics focused on oncology, immunology, or related field.

  • Proficiency and experience programming using R and/or Python.

  • Proficiency in statistical models and analysis of clinical data. Some ML experience a strong plus.

  • Proficiency in visualizations and faceting of molecular data necessary (oncoplots, heatmaps, PCA, etc.).

  • Experience with efficacy, baseline demographic, and other outcome data generated in a clinical trial.

  • Experience with statistical methods i.e. survival analysis, and causal inference.

  • Expertise in bioinformatic analysis of cancer signaling pathways and driver mutations.

  • Experience in tools to analyze cancer genomics data types (RNA, WES, ctDNA, etc) and common tool outputs (GATK, Salmon, OncoKB, VEP, etc.) preferred.

Preferred Skills:

  • Development with professional software development systems and methods (e.g. IDE’s, ticketing systems, version control systems).

  • Familiarity with large public/private genomic data sets (GDC, TCGA, etc.).

description:
About the Role

Tessera is developing in vivo CAR-T therapies, using targeted lipid nanoparticles to deliver CAR mRNA directly to T cells. We're looking for a Research Associate to join our Platform team. You'll run experiments that move our CAR-T programs forward, generate high-quality data, and build your skills in experimental design and analysis alongside experienced scientists. This role suits someone who is detail-oriented, eager to learn, and excited to grow their scientific career in cell therapy.

Your experience includes… 

  • BS in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, immunology, or related field with 2+ years of industry experience, or an MS with 0–2 years of industry experience (co-ops and internships count toward the degree, not work experience)
  • Working knowledge of immune-cell biology, with hands-on experience in mammalian or primary cell culture and flow cytometry; exposure to data analysis tools such as FlowJo and to functional assays such as cytotoxicity, proliferation, or cytokine release is a plus
  • Laboratory experience in an academic or industry setting, with the ability to follow established protocols accurately and keep thorough, organized records
  • Strong data analysis skills and attention to detail
  • Clear communication, a collaborative spirit, and a positive, flexible approach to changing priorities

Nice to have…

  • Experience with CAR-T or other engineered cell therapies
  • Experience with mRNA or lipid nanoparticle delivery and characterization, including dose-response studies
  • Familiarity with in vivo models for cell therapy, such as humanized mouse models
  • Experience with plate-based assays, ELISA, or qPCR
  • Familiarity with basic statistics or data tools

You are interested in… 

  • Executing experiments using established methods and techniques, including cell culture and flow cytometry, with supervision and guidance from senior team members
  • Planning basic to moderately complex experiments for specific projects, consulting with your supervisor on design and methods
  • Analyzing data, evaluating its quality, and recognizing patterns, anomalies, or inconsistencies, reporting unexpected results to your supervisor
  • Operating and maintaining laboratory equipment, and documenting experiments and results accurately in the electronic lab notebook
  • Contributing data, analyses, and summaries to project team reports and meetings
  • Helping troubleshoot routine technical issues and beginning to suggest improvements or alternative approaches
  • Managing and prioritizing your work as project needs change
  • Building working relationships within your team and learning how your work connects to broader program goals

About you: 

You're an early-career scientist who loves time at the bench and wants to build your career in cell therapy. You've worked hands-on with mammalian or primary immune cells and run flow cytometry, and you're comfortable following established protocols closely while keeping careful, organized records. On the Platform team, you'll put those skills to work running the cell culture, flow-based, and functional assays that test how well our targeted LNPs deliver CAR mRNA to T cells. You look closely at your data, notice when something doesn't look right, and raise it with your team. You adapt easily when priorities shift, communicate clearly, and are eager to take on more of the experimental design as your skills grow.

Tessera employees are creative and collaborative problem solvers. They have a strong sense of integrity and unwavering commitment to scientific excellence. 

Meet your Manager:

All inquiries regarding the posted position should be directed to the Talent Partner (see below). Interested individuals must apply directly to be considered for the opening. 

Florence Caro, Associate Director, Molecular Design & Screening

Florence Caro is an Associate Director at Tessera Therapeutics, where she leads polypeptide engineering and screening for the CAR-T program. She sets the team’s scientific strategy and works with cross-functional partners to advance candidates toward in vivo studies.

Florence joined Tessera in 2022 on the Platform team. There she built high-throughput screening assays for the domains of Tessera’s Rewriter polypeptide and worked with the ML/AI team to identify candidates that improve gene editing efficiency. She earned her PhD at UCSF in the DeRisi lab and completed a postdoc at Harvard Medical School in the Mekalanos lab. Her expertise spans molecular biology, genomics, cell biology, and microbiology.

Ben Hoogheem – Senior Director, Head of Benefits & Talent Acquisition

Ben leads benefits and talent acquisition at Tessera Therapeutics. He shapes how the company attracts great people and supports them once they’re here.

Ben started his career as an in vivo pharmacologist. That work gave him a lasting appreciation for the rigor, creativity, and collaboration behind scientific discovery, and it still shapes how he builds organizations where science can thrive.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
About us 

Constructor Labs is the research arm of Constructor Knowledge, based at Campus Ring 1 in Bremen, Germany. Our work is organized around three units: Knowledge Labs, Cyber Labs and Science Labs. We apply computing, software and robotics research to make scientists, teachers and students more effective, working with institutional partners that include CERN, NUS, Carnegie Mellon and Fraunhofer. 

Constructor Practice is the hands-on practice platform within the Constructor Technology learning suite, alongside Learn, Assess, Proctor, Schedule and Groups. It spans an unusually broad portfolio: curriculum-aligned virtual science labs; the evidence-based intervention products Calcularis (numeracy and dyscalculia), Grafari/Orthograph (literacy and dyslexia); and browser-based Software & IT and Coding labs for technical training. Shared capabilities include cloud-based hands-on environments with no installation, automated assessment and grading, group assignments and instructor assistance, LMS integration, and learner analytics and dashboards. 

The product is in production across three distinct markets. Higher education and research, schools and public education authorities, and corporate and vocational training. The platform operates under GDPR, FERPA, COPPA and SOPIPA commitments. 

About the Role

You will own Constructor Practice content portfolio of products (currently includes Practice: Science Labs and Practice: Schools Math and Literacy with future extension to other disciplines) end to end: strategy, roadmap, commercial performance and delivery. This is a lead product management position with full accountability for the product line rather than for a single feature area or squad. 

The scope is wider than a conventional PM role. You will sit in front of clients during presales, shape the go-to-market with sales and marketing, define the roadmap across a portfolio serving three different buyer types, and work with product owners and engineering to bring releases in on time and on budget. Where the product line needs something that has no owner, it is yours. 

Practice has an established customer base and a portfolio that has grown through acquisition and expansion into markets with little in common: a Swiss canton buying dyscalculia intervention for primary schools has almost nothing in common with Acronis training its partner ecosystem. Bringing coherence to that portfolio, deciding what to invest in, what to standardize and what to retire, is the central problem of this role. 

Reporting and scope 

  • Reports to: Head of SI and Edu, Constructor Labs. 
  • Level: Lead Product Manager. You will lead the product team including product owners, engineers and subject matter experts, with a view to building a larger product team as the line grows. 
  • Product surface: all Constructor Practice content products, namely Science Labs, Calcularis, Grafari/Orthograph, Software & IT and Coding, in cooperation with the shared platform layer covering assessment, analytics, LMS integration and deployment.

description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 

 

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

 

Your impact 

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do 

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

  • Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.
  • Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.
  • Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.
  • Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

  • Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure  candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

  • Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.

title: Accessioning Team Runner
description:
POSITION SUMMARY - On site position in Austin, TX 

* This job does not qualify and/or is not eligible for sponsorship.

The Accessioning Team Runner collects, sorts, and transports packages to Accessioning laboratory.   This position is located on site in our Austin, TX location.  Schedules listed below and pay starts at $17.    
 
Schedule:  Tuesday - Saturday, 10am-630pm 
  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sort and transport packages from the Shipping dock to the Accessioning laboratory.

  • Pick up packages from the receptionist’s desk.

  • Scan all tracking numbers into a Google spreadsheet and ensure that tracking numbers are scanned in correctly and spreadsheet is filled out completely.

  • Distribute packages to the Clinical Data Operators (CDO) in a timely and efficient manner following distribution guidelines.

  • Rack samples that arrive in bulk (without individual kit boxes) ensuring that the paperwork matches up with the samples.

  • Escalate any issues or discrepancies to the Leads or Supervisor.

  • Empty bins filled with kit boxes at the CDO workstations into carts placed at designated locations in the lab.

  • Perform a visual check of the kit boxes to make sure that there is no PHI on the kit boxes or samples remaining in the discarded kit boxes.

  • Empty biohazard cans in the lab.

  • Scan bench worksheets.

  • Scan documents into cases.

  • Maintain tidiness of Runner workstations.

  • Store requisition forms by date into the filing cabinets.

  • Dispose of requisition forms into the shred bins that have exceeded the retention period.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Notify Supervisor and Leads of any packaging issues or discrepancies

  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job

  • Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma (or equivalent) required.

  • Previous computer experience.

  •  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Familiar with Google documents.

  • Ability to perform basic calculations.

  • Organized and self- motivated.

  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently.

 

 

 

 

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!
